summary: Diagnosed receipt b740399477124e1b839d1ead222ea5f6 as a second probe fault: promise_seen/acceptsync_seen were false although node 5 held the new promise, because the route helper re-queued the withheld Prepare, so node 5 promised early and the leader's AcceptSync to it landed in the held acknowledgements instead of reaching node 5 before sampling. Kept the regression claim unresolved, recorded that the AcceptSync was produced but withheld by the probe, and submitted a successor that extracts withheld messages from the queue and delivers the late Promise and its AcceptSync directly. Both runtime findings remain as previously recorded.
